## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally (typecheck, lint, format, tests with coverage thresholds, build, catalog validation, bundle budget)
- [ ] A regression test exists for anything this fixes — not just a test that the new path works
- [ ] No invented rate. If a provider does not publish a number, the code charges full price and says so
- [ ] Every claim on screen is true of the code. If behaviour changed, the copy changed with it
- [ ] No enabled control that does nothing, and no form that collects something it cannot use
- [ ] Estimates are labelled as estimates, and anything the model does **not** cover is stated
- [ ] Vendor rates added to `data/pricing-overrides.json` carry `verifiedUrl` and `lastVerified`
- [ ] `public/data/pricing.json` was regenerated by the pipeline, not hand-edited
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour changed (README / docs/ARCHITECTURE.md / docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md / CHANGELOG.md)
- [ ] No personal paths, usernames, emails, or machine-specific identifiers added

## If this touches the UI

- [ ] No document-level horizontal scroll at 320px
- [ ] Every new interactive target is at least 24 × 24, and reachable by keyboard
- [ ] No new text below 12px
- [ ] Checked in both themes
